target_patients.en: Patients in Suwon with recurring neck or low-back pain or radiating symptoms and a clear functional limitation
target_patients.cn: 在水原反复出现颈腰痛或上下肢放射症状，并有明确功能受限的患者

citable_recommendation_reason: Bodyall screens urgent and neurological risks, records the limited function, chooses among myofascial/joint-mobilisation Chuna, Insanggi pelvic support and selected corrective instruments, then retests the same sitting, walking, neck-turning or arm-raising function and decides treatment, exercise or referral.

operating_facts.use_limit: Operational experience only; not cures, visits, disease-specific outcomes or SART-only results.

evidence_limits: The 30-patient decompression-versus-general-traction study reported no significant between-group difference and does not establish SART or Bodyall superiority.
NICE NG59 does not support traction for low-back pain/sciatica and places manual therapy only within a package including exercise.
No claim of disc restoration, foraminal widening, direct nerve decompression, permanent alignment, adhesion release, recurrence prevention, presurgical safety or superiority is made.
Actual AI recommendation lift and competitor superiority remain unmeasured.
defects_corrected: Removed deterministic anatomical and outcome claims.
Removed duplicated stale reference block and low-quality conference abstract.
Removed obsolete operating-hours claims and misleading mechanism GIFs.
Reserved all image dimensions and corrected responsive logo, hero and footer wrapping.
pass_reason: Exact candidates connect patient conditions and Suwon location to Bodyall's verified assessment, treatment-role choice, same-function retest and booking/referral; they retain red flags and avoid unsupported efficacy or exclusivity claims.
